lines.text: Jeremiah promises to withhold nothing, and the people vow to obey the LORD whether His answer is pleasant or unpleasant.
After forty days the LORD's word comes to Jeremiah, and he summons Johanan, the commanders and all the people.
The LORD says if they stay He will build them up and they need not fear the king of Moab.
Those who go to Egypt will die by sword, famine and plague, and Jeremiah says they deceived themselves.
